# apple_users (Data Source)

Lists the team members that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_users" "admins" {
  roles = ["ADMIN"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Only users given access to this app with `apple_user_visible_app`.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles to match: users with any of them. Values: `ACCOUNT_HOLDER`, `ADMIN`, `FINANCE`, `SALES`, `MARKETING`, `APP_MANAGER`, `DEVELOPER`, `ACCESS_TO_REPORTS`, `CUSTOMER_SUPPORT`, `CREATE_APPS`, `CLOUD_MANAGED_DEVELOPER_ID`, `CLOUD_MANAGED_APP_DISTRIBUTION`, `GENERATE_INDIVIDUAL_KEYS`.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The matching users, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `all_apps_visible` (Boolean) Whether the user can see every app.
- `email` (String) Email address the user signs in with.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the user.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `provisioning_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the user can access Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles of the user.
